hebrewText: גַּ֣ם מִ/גָּבֹ֤הַּ יִרָ֨אוּ֙ וְ/חַתְחַתִּ֣ים בַּ/דֶּ֔רֶךְ וְ/יָנֵ֤אץ הַ/שָּׁקֵד֙ וְ/יִסְתַּבֵּ֣ל הֶֽ/חָגָ֔ב וְ/תָפֵ֖ר הָֽ/אֲבִיּוֹנָ֑ה כִּֽי הֹלֵ֤ךְ הָ/אָדָם֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ית עוֹלָמ֔/וֹ וְ/סָבְב֥וּ בָ/שּׁ֖וּק הַ/סֹּפְדִֽים

tokens.bdb: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
tokens.kjv: again, alike, also, (so much) as (soon), both (so)...and, but, either...or, even, for all, (in) likewise (manner), moreover, nay...neither, one, then(-refore), though, what, with, yea.

tokens.bdb: elevated (or elated), powerful, arrogant
tokens.kjv: haughty, height, high(-er), lofty, proud, [idiom] exceeding proudly.

tokens.bdb: to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten
tokens.kjv: affright, be (make) afraid, dread(-ful), (put in) fear(-ful, -fully, -ing), (be had in) reverence(-end), [idiom] see, terrible (act, -ness, thing).

tokens.bdb: terror
tokens.kjv: fear.

tokens.bdb: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
tokens.kjv: along, away, because of, [phrase] by, conversation, custom, (east-) ward, journey, manner, passenger, through, toward, (high-) (path-) way(-side), whither(-soever).
tokens.explanation: derek — caminho, estrada, modo de vida, conduta

tokens.bdb: to scorn;
tokens.kjv: abhor, (give occasion to) blaspheme, contemn, despise, flourish, [idiom] great, provoke.

tokens.bdb: the almond (tree or nut; as being the earliest in bloom)
tokens.kjv: almond (tree).

tokens.bdb: to carry (literally or figuratively), or (reflexively) be burdensome; specifically, to be gravid
tokens.kjv: bear, be a burden, carry, strong to labour.

tokens.bdb: a locust
tokens.kjv: locust.

tokens.bdb: to break up (usually figuratively), i.e. to violate, frustrate
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any ways, break (asunder), cast off, cause to cease, [idiom] clean, defeat, disannul, disappoint, dissolve, divide, make of none effect, fail, frustrate, bring (come) to nought, [idiom] utterly, make void.

tokens.bdb: provocative of desire; the caper berry (from its stimulative taste)
tokens.kjv: desire.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: provocative of desire; the caper berry
tokens.enLiteralWord: provocative of desire; the caper berry
tokens.explanation: provocative of desire; the caper berry
tokens.explanationEn: provocative of desire; the caper berry

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
tokens.enLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanation: ki — conjunção causal e explicativa: porque, pois, que, quando
tokens.explanationEn: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.bdb: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
tokens.kjv: (all) along, apace, behave (self), come, (on) continually, be conversant, depart, [phrase] be eased, enter, exercise (self), [phrase] follow, forth, forward, get, go (about, abroad, along, away, forward, on, out, up and down), [phrase] greater, grow, be wont to haunt, lead, march, [idiom] more and more, move (self), needs, on, pass (away), be at the point, quite, run (along), [phrase] send, speedily, spread, still, surely, [phrase] tale-bearer, [phrase] travel(-ler), walk (abroad, on, to and fro, up and down, to places), wander, wax, (way-) faring man, [idiom] be weak, whirl.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to walk (in a great variety of applications
tokens.enLiteralWord: to walk (in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanation: to walk (in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanationEn: to walk (in a great variety of applications

tokens.bdb: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] another, [phrase] hypocrite, [phrase] common sort, [idiom] low, man (mean, of low degree), person.
tokens.enLiteralWord: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species
tokens.explanation: adam — ser humano, homem, a humanidade como espécie
tokens.explanationEn: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).
tokens.explanation: el — preposição de direção: a, para, em direção a

tokens.bdb: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
tokens.kjv: court, daughter, door, [phrase] dungeon, family, [phrase] forth of, [idiom] great as would contain, hangings, home(born), (winter) house(-hold), inside(-ward), palace, place, [phrase] prison, [phrase] steward, [phrase] tablet, temple, web, [phrase] within(-out).
tokens.enLiteralWord: a house (in the greatest variation of applications
tokens.explanationEn: a house (in the greatest variation of applications

tokens.bdb: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
tokens.kjv: alway(-s), ancient (time), any more, continuance, eternal, (for, (n-)) ever(-lasting, -more, of old), lasting, long (time), (of) old (time), perpetual, at any time, (beginning of the) world ([phrase] without end). Compare H5331 (נֶצַח), H5703 (עַד).

tokens.bdb: to revolve, surround, or border; used in various applications, literally and figuratively
tokens.kjv: bring, cast, fetch, lead, make, walk, [idiom] whirl, [idiom] round about, be about on every side, apply, avoid, beset (about), besiege, bring again, carry (about), change, cause to come about, [idiom] circuit, (fetch a) compass (about, round), drive, environ, [idiom] on every side, beset (close, come, compass, go, stand) round about, inclose, remove, return, set, sit down, turn (self) (about, aside, away, back).

tokens.bdb: a street (as run over)
tokens.kjv: street.

tokens.bdb: properly, to tear the hair and beat the breasts (as Orientals do in grief); generally to lament; by implication, to wail
tokens.kjv: lament, mourn(-er), wail.
